entries.classification: published EIA-860 generator roster, zero free parameters (rule 14 [R-ACCURATE] capacity-representation repair)
entries.source: EIA-860 operable generator sheet (data/raw/eia-860/eia860_generator_operable.parquet): Prime Mover, Energy Source 1, Unit Code, Operating Year, Summer/Nameplate Capacity. Predicate: data.fleet.eia860.cc_steam_part_generators. ISO gate: config.plant_taxonomy.CC_STEAM_PART_REPAIR_ISOS. Heat rate: the eGRID plant rate already joined onto the block's CT siblings (6.9573 MMBtu/MWh at 55088 under measured_chp_heat_rates). The Phase-0 identification record — the census, the fleet-presence cross-check against each plant's EIA-860 TOTALS, and the five pre-registered properties — is committed in results/calibration/_miso126_cc_steam_part_screen.json and scripts/probes/_miso126_cc_steam_part_screen.py.
entries.why_zero: Nothing is chosen, tuned or swept. Every clause of the predicate is an equality on a published categorical field (Prime Mover == 'CA', Energy Source 1 != 'NG', non-empty Unit Code, a sibling with Prime Mover == 'CT' and Energy Source 1 == 'NG') plus one physical inequality (the steam part is not older than the oldest such sibling — an HRSG is commissioned with or after the turbines whose exhaust drives it). The restored capacity is the published Summer Capacity and the heat rate is the block's existing one, so the mechanism introduces no new numeric value at all. Rule 13 [R-MEASURED]: a generator's existence, prime mover, unit code, vintage and capacity are INPUTS that regenerate for any forward year and respond to changed conditions (a retirement or re-rate moves them) — not a measured outcome fed back to close a residual. Rule 23 [R-FROZEN-DERIVE]: the paired CHP artifact re-derive cites the fleet/denominator change and moves ONE descriptive cell (class_capacity_mw 350.0 -> 600.0), leaving every applied rate byte-identical. Rule 19 [R-ONE-MECH]: nothing is stacked on the already-armed measured_chp_heat_rates, which keeps its single plant-grain rate — this changes the capacity that rate applies to, not the rate. n_residual is unchanged.

exceptions.metric: hours RT-expressible LMP > $200/MWh (C3c scarcity tail, actual RT hourly gate; Indiana Hub)
exceptions.classification: MODEL MISS (structural - MISO administrative ORDC/RCPF scarcity tail, not an emergent marginal-cost outcome even in MISO's own SCED; representation-frontier caveat, every admissible mechanism tried on record per rule #1)
exceptions.reason: MISO's real scarcity tail is an administrative stepped ORDC/RCPF curve DERIVED FROM a Monte-Carlo LOLP simulation over 10-30 min net-load/outage uncertainty (MISO Scarcity Pricing White Paper Mar-2024 §3.2.1; energy steps $1,100/$2,100 anchored to $3,500 VOLL, per-product reserve curves, BPM-002 Att.B §5.4; Potomac Economics IMM 2024 MISO SOM; OSTI 2424806). It prices probabilistic short-term risk a deterministic perfect-foresight hourly LP does not contain; the generic PCM literature confirms deterministic LPs systematically under-produce the spike tail (arXiv 2101.02303, 23/23-model survey; PyPSA-Eur arXiv 2606.16486). Empirical confirmation on the miso-81 keeper's OWN hourly output: in the 88 actual 2025 Indiana-Hub RT>$200 hours the model prices ~$50 median / $157 max, the reserve adder fires 2/88, energy+reserve>$200 in 1/88, zero load-shed; those hours are mostly low in the DA market (e.g. RT $1,598 / DA $99), and a deterministic LP ~= the DA market, so it cannot manufacture them. Reaching the tail would require MANUFACTURING the uncertainty (rules #1/#10 forbid the fitted path); layering an ORDC/RCPF adder would fire ~2 hours, not the actual count. Frontier designation 2026-07-20: every named admissible mechanism tried on record and adopted (reserve deliverability / 10-min ramp caps miso-39; Midwest sub-regional reserves miso-71; measured reserve requirements miso-56); further work needs a NEW admissible measured identification, its own charter. NEVER an offer adder tuned to the tail. See docs/multi-iso/miso-scarcity-tail-external-validation-2026-07.md + docs/multi-iso/miso-scarcity-tail-diagnosis.md.
exceptions.magnitude_basis: this run's own scored value (miso-268); the classification and reason are the standing MISO adjudication carried forward
